posts.cooked:
Matchstickman:

This question was asked … somewhere and the answer was "Good question! I'll ask Adam." No answer since then.

Yup, I asked that question. And as Matchstickman said, the response was they'd check with Adam. At this point, I'd be surprised if it was all new art, though.  This campaign alone is giving us a bunch of new promos:

  • 1 for each hero introduced thus far (7)

  • 1 for each hero without a promo already (5 since Skyscraper has 3)

  • 1 for Guise, Captain Cosmic, and Visionary (3)

  • X-TREME PRIME WARDENS!!! (5)

  • (Assuming) new promos for each member of Void Guard as well (4)

That's 20 promos that we currently know about. That's not counting the 11 new heroes needing a non-promo hero cards (31 total), they would need to be counted for the foil pack as well.

That would mean, for the foil pack (which includes alternate art for all original hero cards as well) and the base game, Adam would need to draw 62 original hero cards to give the promo packs "all original art". Just counting this expansion. At this point, it just doesn't seem worth it.

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
Here are some answers!

1) Someone asked a while back if the unlocked mini-expansions, and promos, and Void Guard expansion, are really free to all backers. The answer is yes, they are really free to all backers.

2) Someone correctly stated this, but I wanted to officially say it here: the Completionist Guise variant will appear in the following products: Ultimate Collector's Case, Complete Hero Variant Collection, and 5th Anniversary Foil Hero Collection. It will not be available outside of those products, so if you are not getting one of those products, you will not get it.

3) Every card in the 5th Anniversary Foil Hero Collection and the Complete Hero Variant Collection will have a different piece of character art on it than any other instance of that card in any other product that is currently available, or that will be available at the time of its release. This means that Adam is going to draw two pieces of character art for each of the new hero variants; one for the regular release, and another for those products.
